review_candidates.description: Role Description The Infrastructure Specialist / Network Infrastructure Analyst / Systems Infrastructure Engineer supports the design, operation, maintenance, and improvement of the organisation’s technology infrastructure. This role helps maintain reliable connectivity, computing capacity, and system availability across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. It identifies technical issues, implements controlled changes, and strengthens infrastructure resilience to support business services. The position works closely with IT Support, Cybersecurity, Application Development, Cloud, Architecture, and technology suppliers. Responsibilities include configuring infrastructure components, monitoring availability and performance, troubleshooting incidents, managing updates, and maintaining technical documentation. The role supports capacity planning, backup and recovery activities, equipment lifecycle management, and infrastructure projects. It also investigates recurring faults and verifies that changes meet operational and security requirements. For Infrastructure Specialist positions, the emphasis is on broad infrastructure administration, maintenance, and service support. Network Infrastructure Analyst positions focus on connectivity, traffic analysis, network performance, and fault investigation. Systems Infrastructure Engineer positions concentrate on server platforms, operating systems, virtualisation, storage, and infrastructure automation. Across these functions, the role maintains accurate configurations, supports recovery testing, and coordinates technical improvements that reduce disruption and improve service reliability. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or relevant technical qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in infrastructure support, network administration, systems engineering, or a comparable technical role. Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, including networking, servers, virtualisation, storage, and cloud services. For Infrastructure Specialist positions, experience maintaining infrastructure platforms, processing technical changes, and resolving service incidents. Ability to monitor system health, investigate alerts, and prioritise issues according to business impact. For Network Infrastructure Analyst positions, knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and wireless networking. Experience using network monitoring and diagnostic tools to investigate connectivity, latency, packet loss, and capacity issues. For Systems Infrastructure Engineer positions, experience administering Windows or Linux servers, virtual machines, and shared infrastructure services. Familiarity with storage management, backup systems, recovery procedures, and availability planning. Experience applying patches, maintaining secure configurations, and coordinating remediation with security teams. Ability to write scripts or use automation tools to simplify repeatable infrastructure tasks and reduce configuration errors. Understanding of identity services, access controls, network segmentation, and infrastructure security principles. Experience maintaining configuration records, network diagrams, operating procedures, and incident documentation. Strong troubleshooting, communication, and coordination skills, including the ability to work effectively with suppliers and application teams. Relevant networking, systems, cloud, or infrastructure certification is an advantage; willingness to support scheduled maintenance or on-call duties where required.
